name: zdi_free_contents
description: zDi::FreeContents releases owned display-instance allocations without freeing the zDi slot itself.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zDi/DI-pool source-cluster pass.

Binary Ninja keeps a limited reconstruction marker because some pointer aliases remain lowered around zDiEntry and point-entry array traversal, but the assembly comments identify the concrete fields and strides used by the original.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x482160 validates null return 5, per-entry freeing and nulling of vertexIndices, normalIndices, and uvPairs, zeroing entryCount, freeing and nulling entries, verts, normals, blendVerts, freeing every pointEntries[i].pointCamList, freeing pointEntries, and returning 0.

The native clone/copy smokes exercise zDi::FreeContents on cloned display instances with allocated vertex, normal, blend, point, point-camera, entry, index, and UV data, while the ref/free smoke verifies the null sentinel path.
